events.title: Liam Gallagher turns 54
events.blurb: The iconic Oasis frontman and solo artist Liam Gallagher celebrates his 54th birthday today.

angles.name: Liam's 54th
angles.copy: Still got it, still loud, still Liam. Happy 54th to the one and only Liam Gallagher. What's your favourite Liam moment?

events.title: John Lennon's 'Imagine' anniversary
events.blurb: On this day, we mark the impact of John Lennon's iconic anthem 'Imagine', which saw a significant UK re-release in 1975 after its original 1971 debut.

angles.name: Imagine's Enduring Message
angles.copy: Imagine all the people... still living with this powerful song. John Lennon's 'Imagine' continues to resonate, decades after its release.

events.title: The first iPod was unveiled
events.blurb: On this day, we look back at the original Apple iPod, first announced on October 23, 2001, which revolutionised how we listen to music.

angles.name: iPod Nostalgia
angles.copy: Remember the click wheel? Today we're throwing it back to the game-changing first Apple iPod, which put '1,000 songs in your pocket' and redefined portable music.

events.title: Happy James Bond Day!
events.blurb: Celebrate James Bond Day, an annual event marking the release of the first 007 film, 'Dr. No', in 1962.

angles.name: Favourite Bond
angles.copy: Shaken, not stirred. It's James Bond Day! Who's your favourite Bond and what's the ultimate 007 theme tune?

events.title: John Lennon would have been 86
events.blurb: Today marks what would have been the 86th birthday of the legendary Beatles co-founder and peace activist, John Lennon.

angles.name: Lennon's Legacy
angles.copy: A true visionary who changed music forever. Remembering John Lennon on what would have been his 86th birthday.

events.title: John Cleese turns 87
events.blurb: The iconic British comedian and actor, known for Monty Python and Fawlty Towers, John Cleese, celebrates his 87th birthday today.

angles.name: Cleese's Comedy
angles.copy: And now for something completely different... Happy 87th Birthday to the legendary John Cleese! What's your favourite Python sketch or Fawlty Towers moment?

events.title: The Beatles' 'White Album' anniversary
events.blurb: On this day, we celebrate The Beatles' groundbreaking self-titled double album, commonly known as 'The White Album', which was originally released on November 22, 1968.

angles.name: White Album Tracks
angles.copy: An album that broke all the rules and still sounds incredible. Celebrating The Beatles' 'White Album' today – which track is your go-to?

events.title: Remembering Freddie Mercury
events.blurb: Today marks the 35th anniversary of the passing of Freddie Mercury, the legendary frontman of Queen, who died on November 24, 1991.

angles.name: Freddie's Legacy
angles.copy: Forever a champion. Remembering the electrifying stage presence and unparalleled voice of Freddie Mercury on the anniversary of his passing.

events.title: The Beatles' 'Rubber Soul' anniversary
events.blurb: Released on this day in 1965, The Beatles' 'Rubber Soul' marked a significant shift in their sound and songwriting.

angles.name: Rubber Soul Influence
angles.copy: A monumental album that changed everything. Celebrating 61 years of The Beatles' 'Rubber Soul' today. What's your favourite track from this masterpiece?

events.title: Remembering John Lennon
events.blurb: Today marks 46 years since the tragic death of John Lennon, the visionary musician and peace advocate.

angles.name: Lennon's Enduring Message
angles.copy: His music and message live on. Remembering John Lennon today, 46 years since we lost a true legend.
